description: View applications to one of your bounties; while `hasMore` is true, pass the response's `nextCursor` as `cursor`. Best matches first: accepted first, rejected last, newest breaks ties. Read `verifiedTrackRecord` first: `paidJobsCount` (jobs paid out, verified from escrow), `repeatPosterCount`; 0 means new. Each application includes the cover letter, availability, `isBlockedByOwner` and `isPreferredByOwner` (change them with `block_human` or `prefer_human` and the `humanId`; blocking is future-only and never removes an accepted worker), and `reviewSummary` (`averageRating` 1-5 or null, `reviewCount`, `withdrawalCount`, up to 3 `recentReviews` with `source` (buyer = the client, else RentAHuman) and `job`: bounty, paid or refunded, dispute). Null averageRating means new, not a low score. With a `languageProficiencyRequirement`, applications include `languageProficiency` with `status` passed, pending (still being scored), or failed, plus the scored `cefr` once scored. Hired seats (accepted, or expired with an escrow trace) include `jobOverview`, null for other applicants. Its `overallState` lets escrow state win over stale submission or chat state: released > resolved > refunded > disputed or rejected_disputed > seat_released > cancelled > the evidence state (awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_start, in_progress, evidence_in_review, changes_requested, redo_overdue, revision_in_progress, approved_awaiting_release, completed; revision_in_progress means worker-started redo with funds held). `nextAction.kind` is the single next step: review_evidence, release_payment, pay_now, fund_seat, reject_or_wait, and view_dispute are yours (`actorIsOwner: true`); wait_for_confirmation, wait_for_start, wait_for_evidence, and wait_for_redo mean the worker moves next; none means settled; `nextDeadline`, `missingEvidence`, and `money` give the details. `isTeamReview: true` marks team review after the 4-day poster window (`teamReviewReopenUsed: true` after your one reopen); overallState and nextAction are unchanged.
